name: delta-mcc-change
operation: yearly fees with the merchant's MCC swapped, minus yearly fees as is
invariant: the merchant's own MCC gives 0; delta = fees(new) − fees(old), both via F03

canonical_method.helper: total_fees_paid(fees, transactions, mcc=<candidate>, ...) — reuse F03's per-month loop for both the current and hypothetical MCC
steps: for each month: stats = monthly_merchant_stats(...); old = sum(total_fees_paid(fees, stats['transactions'], mcc=info['merchant_category_code'], account_type=..., capture_delay=cd_bucket, monthly_fraud_level=..., monthly_volume=...).values())
new = same call with mcc=<hypothetical mcc>
delta = sum(new) - sum(old) across months, rounded to 6 decimals

conflict_ruling: task 2537's per-month total_fees_paid loop (old mcc vs new mcc, both bucketed via monthly_merchant_stats) is the right shape; task 2551 abandoned the helper module entirely mid-task after a 120s timeout and fell back to raw pd.read_csv/json.load, which both burns the turn budget and produced a malformed prose answer instead of a number.
pitfalls: Recomputing total_fees_paid from scratch with raw pandas/json after a timeout (2551) instead of simplifying the existing helper-based call — burns the turn budget and produces an unparseable answer
Two of three probe tasks (2537, 2551) disagreed between pass 1 and pass 2 — this family is currently unstable even before checking correctness
No dev-10 anchor exists yet, so a plausible-looking delta (e.g. 2544's 0.0 'MCCs are grouped identically') cannot currently be trusted without gold verification
prompt_rule: if the question asks the fee delta from hypothetically changing a merchant's MCC for a year → reuse the F03 per-month total_fees_paid loop twice (old mcc, new mcc) and subtract; never fall back to raw pd.read_csv/json.load on a timeout — simplify the existing helper call instead; format: number rounded to 6 decimals.
note: Needs a dev-10 gold anchor before it can be promoted past provisional even after the timeout/format bug is fixed.
